warnings: Pile caps on I-0.18 x 0.18 m piles, SAFE LOAD 13 ตัน/ต้น: F1 1 pile, F2 2 piles. Pile length not printed.
Depth chain on both details: 1.00 from ระดับดินเดิม to the top of the cap, cap 0.50, lean concrete 0.05, compacted sand 0.05.

main_bar.count is the two-way total. F2 prints 8-DB12 (leader to the cut bar dots in the 0.90-long section = bars along the 0.36 side) and 7-DB12 (leader to the long bottom bar) — read as 8 short + 7 long, as on the sibling siamplan sets; flagged lower.
The stub column C2 is drawn with ties inside both details but its size and bars are not printed anywhere in the set.
